---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement for the Morph blog example
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem
What's the use case or pain point this would solve?

## Proposed solution
How you'd like it to work. Code snippets / mockups welcome.

## Alternatives considered
Other approaches you've thought about.

## Additional context
Anything else that would help — links to similar implementations, screenshots, etc.

> **Note:** for SDK feature requests (changes to `@morphuiapp/morphui` itself),
> please open an issue on the [SDK repository](https://github.com/morphuiapp/morphui)
> instead. This repo is for the example blog only.
